title: Rite Here Rite Now (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
studio_context: Recorded live at the Kia Forum, Inglewood, on 11 and 12 September 2023, the last North American dates of the Re-Imperatour, for the concert film.

drum_performances.name: The Nameless Ghoul on drums
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The drumming ghoul's own playing, live: eighteen songs across every era (Kaisarion, Rats, Cirice, Mary on a Cross, Dance Macabre, Square Hammer). The touring band is credited as 'Ghouls and Ghoulettes'.

evidence.note: The credit names the touring drummer; the name is not stored here. The patterns are from studio-version tabs of songs on it.
